items.rationale: The values 100 or more are 120, 100 and 150. >= includes 100 itself. 120 + 100 + 150 = 370.
The values below 80 are 45 and 60 (80 itself is not below 80). 45 + 60 = 105.
> means strictly greater than, so a value of exactly 100 does not qualify. >= means greater than or equal to, so 100 does qualify.

Join the operator text and the cell value with &, giving ">=100" when F1 holds 100. Inside quotes, F1 is just the letters F and 1. Without quotes, >=F1 is not a valid criteria argument, and the + version tries to add text to a number, which gives #VALUE!.
